prompt.zh-TW: 延伸指標（課程 Excel 有這一項，現行採 IFRS 的財務分析格式不列）：綠丘單車行今年營業利益 {{money:vars.oi}}，股本（實收資本）{{money:vars.capital}}。依課程 Excel 口徑計算{{term:tm_7km3j04r|plain}}，以百分比作答。
prompt.en: Extension ratio (in the course Excel but not in the current IFRS-based financial analysis format): Green Hill Cycles had operating profit of {{money:vars.oi}} and share capital (paid-in capital) of {{money:vars.capital}} this year. Using the course Excel basis, what is the {{term:tm_7km3j04r|plain}}? Answer as a percentage.

explanation.zh-TW: {{term:tm_7km3j04r}}＝{{term:tm_z3vbt800}} ÷ {{term:tm_5e3py55a}}，回答「本業的利益相對股東投入的股本有多少」。網站把它列為延伸指標：公式照課程，但現行採 IFRS 的財務分析格式（例如公開說明書）在相對實收資本的比率中只列{{term:tm_bkqw8c59|plain}}，營業利益這一列只出現在採用 IFRS 以前的舊格式；年報準則在 {{raw:2024}} 年 8 月 1 日修正後，年報也不再要求刊載財務分析表（現行規定，查證於 {{raw:2026-10-24}}）。
explanation.en: {{term:tm_7km3j04r}} = {{term:tm_z3vbt800}} ÷ {{term:tm_5e3py55a}}: how large the core business’s profit is relative to the capital the shareholders paid in. The site lists it as an extension ratio: the formula follows the course, but among the ratios to paid-in capital, the current IFRS-based financial analysis format (in a prospectus, for example) lists only the {{term:tm_bkqw8c59|plain}}; the operating profit line appears only in the older pre-IFRS format, and since the annual report rules were amended on 1 August {{raw:2024}}, annual reports no longer have to include a financial analysis table (current rules, checked on {{raw:2026-10-24}}).
